subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, or replace it with a new same-repository fix for the shared bootstrap report helper?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are clear, but an open linked fork PR already owns the candidate patch, so cleanup automation should not queue a duplicate implementation without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing candidate branch as the fix path if its diff and proof are acceptable after maintainer review.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow PR
options.body: Close or ignore the fork candidate and ask for a new same-repository PR that applies the same shared-helper fallback with focused tests.

options.title: Leave waiting on contributor
options.body: Keep the issue open and wait for the fork PR author to refresh proof or maintenance state before acting.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate branch as the fix path if its diff and proof are acceptable after maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared bootstrap stats helper and truncation/reporting path most directly trace to this area history.
